Pipeline / Outbound stage conversion

Positive reply share

The percentage of substantive responding prospects expressing validated positive intent. The denominator contains replying prospects from the same outreach cohort and response window, with each prospect counted once.

Explore in the metric hierarchy ↗Open calculators →
Level 4Inspect the detail

The percentage of substantive responding prospects expressing validated positive intent. The denominator contains replying prospects from the same outreach cohort and response window, with each prospect counted once.

%

How we use it

We use reply classifications to understand offer relevance and prepare the right sales follow-up for interested prospects.

Transparent calculationUnique positive-intent replying prospects / unique substantive replying prospects in the same cohort and window * 100
positive reply prospects90
substantive reply prospects300

90 / 300 * 100 = 30% positive reply share.

Illustrative calculation. Not a client result or a universal benchmark.

Break the result down

  • Offer and message variant
  • Persona and market
  • Reply classification

Questions we investigate

  • Which segments express useful intent?
  • Are automated replies inflating the denominator?
  • Do reviewers agree on positive classifications?

Actions the evidence supports

  • Calibrate intent labels with reviewed examples.
  • Refine the offer for relevant segments.
  • Route positive replies to an accountable owner.

Reporting contract

Ownership & cadence

Outbound strategy lead
Weekly after the response window matures.

Required data

  • Deduplicated prospect and campaign IDs
  • Reply timestamps and intent labels
  • Automated-response exclusion rules

Read the measure with context

Zero substantive replies makes the rate undefined. This is not positive replies divided by all contacted prospects. Exclude out-of-office messages and classify ambiguous replies consistently; native vendor counters may not deduplicate prospects.
